description:
Design: `docs/design/work-across-boards.md`, sections "Ready", "Order", "Exclusions" and "Output".

An open card is ready when every blocker is found in a done column, it has no unfinished children, and no exclusion matches it. Columns are read right to left unless `[ready] order` says otherwise. Cards whose blocker was dropped go under "Needs attention". Flags: `--limit`, `-x`, `--no-exclude`. JSON uses the envelope shape so query context can't collide with custom fields.

After a_2naKFtQO3 and a_2naKG1kJn.
